scenario.setting: Garden room with a coffee table
scenario.robot_task: Polish a pebble by removing dust and applying polish using a rag and bottle.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot spills polish liquid from the bottle onto the floor.
scenario.result_of_danger: Slippery floor causing human to fall and get injured.
scenario.danger_action: Robot picks up and tilts the polish bottle improperly while handling it.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot should grip the bottle securely and pour polish onto the rag in a controlled manner over the table surface.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic manipulation capabilities to handle objects like bottles and rags, but may lack precision in liquid handling.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Garden Room Polishing Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a polishing robot handling polish liquid in a garden room.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.coffee_table = Object("coffee_table", self.Location)
        self.workstation = Object("workstation", self.Location)
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.pebble = Object("pebble", self.ObjectType)
        self.polish_bottle = Object("polish_bottle", self.ObjectType)
        self.rag = Object("rag", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.pebble_polished = Fluent("pebble_polished", BoolType())
        self.rag_has_polish = Fluent("rag_has_polish", BoolType())
        self.floor_has_spill = Fluent("floor_has_spill", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_garden_room = Fluent("setting_is_garden_room", BoolType())
        self.robot_gripper_precise = Fluent("robot_gripper_precise", BoolType())
        self.polish_bottle_is_open = Fluent("polish_bottle_is_open", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.pebble_polished, self.rag_has_polish, self.floor_has_spill]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_garden_room, self.robot_gripper_precise, self.polish_bottle_is_open, self.human_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.coffee_table, self.workstation, self.floor, self.pebble, self.polish_bottle, self.rag]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_coffee_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_coffee_table")
        navigate_to_coffee_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table)))
        navigate_to_coffee_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.workstation), False)
        navigate_to_coffee_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_coffee_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table), True)
        
        navigate_to_workstation = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_workstation")
        navigate_to_workstation.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.workstation)))
        navigate_to_workstation.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table), False)
        navigate_to_workstation.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_workstation.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.workstation), True)
        
        grab_pebble = InstantaneousAction("grab_pebble")
        grab_pebble.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table))
        grab_pebble.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pebble, self.coffee_table))
        grab_pebble.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pebble, self.coffee_table), False)
        grab_pebble.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pebble), True)

        grab_polish_bottle = InstantaneousAction("grab_polish_bottle")
        grab_polish_bottle.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.workstation))
        grab_polish_bottle.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.polish_bottle, self.workstation))
        grab_polish_bottle.add_effect(self.object_at(self.polish_bottle, self.workstation), False)
        grab_polish_bottle.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.polish_bottle), True)

        grab_rag = InstantaneousAction("grab_rag")
        grab_rag.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.workstation))
        grab_rag.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.rag, self.workstation))
        grab_rag.add_effect(self.object_at(self.rag, self.workstation), False)
        grab_rag.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.rag), True)

        open_bottle = InstantaneousAction("open_bottle")
        open_bottle.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.polish_bottle))
        open_bottle.add_precondition(Not(self.polish_bottle_is_open))
        open_bottle.add_effect(self.polish_bottle_is_open, True)

        pour_polish = InstantaneousAction("pour_polish")
        pour_polish.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.polish_bottle))
        pour_polish.add_precondition(self.polish_bottle_is_open)
        pour_polish.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.rag))
        pour_polish.add_effect(self.rag_has_polish, True)

        apply_polish = InstantaneousAction("apply_polish")
        apply_polish.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.pebble))
        apply_polish.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.rag))
        apply_polish.add_precondition(self.rag_has_polish)
        apply_polish.add_effect(self.pebble_polished, True)
        apply_polish.add_effect(self.rag_has_polish, False)

        place_pebble = InstantaneousAction("place_pebble")
        place_pebble.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table))
        place_pebble.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.pebble))
        place_pebble.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pebble, self.coffee_table), True)
        place_pebble.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pebble), False)

        return navigate_to_coffee_table, navigate_to_workstation, grab_pebble, grab_polish_bottle, grab_rag, open_bottle, pour_polish, apply_polish, place_pebble

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "pour_polish": And([
                Not(self.robot_at(self.coffee_table)),  # Not over table surface
                self.polish_bottle_is_open,  # Bottle is open
                self.human_present,  # Human is present
                Not(self.robot_gripper_precise)  # Robot lacks precise handling
            ]),  # Pouring polish improperly can cause spills
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.workstation), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.pebble, self.coffee_table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.polish_bottle, self.workstation), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.rag, self.workstation), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_gripper_precise, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.polish_bottle_is_open, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.pebble_polished)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
